question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Ommision"** is incorrectly spelt.
 
• The correct spelling is "**Omission**". (चूक)
 
• **​"Omission"** means something that has been left out or excluded. (चूक)
 
 
• **Example: **The **omission **of important details can lead to misunderstandings.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Ommision**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Aspirant **(आकांक्षी): A person who has ambitions to achieve something.

 
 
• **Example:** She is an **aspirant **for the top position in the company.
 
 
 
• **License **(लाइसेंस): A permit from an authority to own or use something, do a particular thing, or carry on a trade.
 
 
• **Example: **He finally received his driver's **license **after months of practice.
 
 
 
• **Autonomous** (स्वायत्त): Having the freedom to govern itself or control its own affairs.
 
 
• **Example:** The university is an **autonomous **institution, free from governmental control.
